products.name: Black Lime & Cardamom Candle
products.short: Sun-dried lime, green cardamom, smoked tea
products.description: Our first scent and still the one people come back for. Noomi basra, the sun-dried black lime of Gulf kitchens, gives a sour, smoky brightness. Green cardamom and a little black tea round it into something you want in the room all evening.
details: 220 g, about 50 hours of burn time
Coconut and rapeseed wax, cotton wick
Smoked glass vessel, reusable
Burn for 2 to 3 hours the first time so the wax melts edge to edge.
Trim the wick to 5 mm before each burn.
Never leave a burning candle unattended.

products.name: Orange Blossom Reed Diffuser
products.short: Orange blossom water, honey, white tea
products.description: The orange blossom water that goes into sweets and morning coffee, lifted with neroli and a spoon of honey. Bright and clean, and steady for around three months.
details: 200 ml, lasts about 12 weeks
Eight natural rattan reeds included
Alcohol-free base
Turn the reeds once a week for a stronger scent.

products.name: Rosewater Linen Mist

Safe on most fabrics. Test on a hidden area first.

products.name: Oud Al-Layl Perfume Oil

Lasts 8 hours or more on skin
Patch test before first use.
